name: command-guard
description: Turns your "never run X" rules into a guard: a Bash command (or a Write/Edit) matching one of your patterns is refused, and Claude reads your reason and what to do instead.

rulesFile.title: Rules file
rulesFile.description: JSON file holding your rules. Default ~/.claude-mods/command-guard.json

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: A short toast naming the rule each time one refuses a call
